summary: Sky Quarry Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Conversion and Exchange Agreement with Libertas Funding LLC on June 29, 2026. The company parties converted and cancelled $3,985,000 in aggregate outstanding merchant cash advance obligations (MCAs) and issued a promissory note of the same principal amount, bearing 8% non-compounding interest with escalating weekly payments. The MCAs were fully satisfied and extinguished, and Libertas granted a general release. Existing security interests remain. This is a debt restructuring without special-situation equity or structural change; it is not a corporate event category. Watch for ongoing liquidity or default triggers.
